scenes.headline: How an LLM turns a prompt into streamed tokens
scenes.sub: Prefill, decode, and the KV cache between them
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Voxel! Every generate call is really two workloads with opposite bottlenecks. Here's the whole path, and where the time goes.

scenes.text: One generate call is two workloads with opposite bottlenecks: a compute-bound prefill and a memory-bound decode.
scenes.say: One generate call is two workloads: a prefill that's limited by arithmetic, and a decode that's limited by memory.

items.say: Embed: each ID becomes a vector, and rotary embeddings add position.
Prefill: the whole prompt runs through every layer at once, filling the KV cache and giving the first token.
Decode: one token per step, attending over the cache, then appending to it.
Last, detokenize: IDs back to text, streamed out.

left.title: Prefill
items: Measured as time to first token
left.say: Prefill multiplies matrices by matrices. It keeps the math units busy, and you feel it as time to first token.

right.title: Decode
right.say: Decode is a matrix times a vector. Almost no math, but every weight and the whole cache stream out of memory each step.

scenes.title: FLOPs per byte read, 7B model in fp16
scenes.note: below the ridge, the math units sit idle waiting on memory
scenes.say: A decode step does about one FLOP per byte it reads. An A100 needs a hundred and fifty-three to stay busy. Batching thirty-two requests reaches about ten.

steps.label: each step appends one entry and reuses the rest
steps.say: The KV cache is why decode does so little math. Each step appends one key and value, and reuses every one already there.

steps.label: PagedAttention: the cache in fixed-size blocks
steps.say: But it grows with every token, in every layer: about one megabyte per token for a 13B model. Paging it in blocks fits more requests.

scenes.text: When decode is slow, more compute does nothing. The bottleneck is the memory bus: optimize the thing that's actually full.
scenes.mark: optimize the thing that's actually full

recap: Prefill is compute-bound: time to first token
The KV cache sets the economics
scenes.say: To recap: prefill is bound by compute, decode by memory, and the KV cache runs the economics.
